dataset: Official public land-acquisition notice and award catalogue references
policy: Catalogue entries and selected project/notice metadata only. Numeric area is retained only where explicitly published by an official source (including exact Ares-to-hectare conversion); compensation remains null unless an official source value was captured. Notice lists are not complete inventories or parcel-level acquisition status. Expanded on 14-Nov-2026 with additional eGazette, Pune District and Puducherry 2026 index entries. These are source-index metadata; parcel/area/compensation values are only populated where explicitly visible in the official title/snippet, and require source-document review. Added 19 official GNCTD award PDFs indexed on 14-Nov-2026; catalogue listing is not itself proof of possession, payment or current title.
